jobs_results.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Position

The Provider Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a
portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across a range of
applications and disease areas.
We are looking for candidates with a deep understanding of modern SaaS architecture and
experience across the full stack with a “create tools, not band-aids” DevOps mindset. If you
would rather improve health outcomes for millions instead of helping sell ads on the Internet,
this is the job for you!
You'll get to build a SaaS business from the ground up with the ability to influence the product
and architecture and lots of opportunities for growth. Plus you’ll get to work side by side with a
team of world-class doctors and researchers who want to impact global healthcare delivery.

The Position:

The Staff DevOps​ ​Engineer​ ​is a key member of engineering and DevOps groups and will apply knowledge of design principles, practices in the implementation of... complex, enterprise-scale software systems. General responsibilities include design concept generation, participating in reviews for components or features, development, and testing of the core infrastructure/software stack, and reliability testing.

The key technologies you will work with are AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, ArgoCD and Argo Workflows.

Your Responsibilities:
• Automation​: Participate in continuous improvement of our infrastructure, CI/CD and SRE
• Empower our engineers: Help develop and choose toolsets and processes that optimise the effectiveness of our developers, shorten time to production and improve quality.
• Leadership​: Ensure a culture that values technical excellence together with support and compassion for individuals

Qualifications:
• BS in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or related field.
• 6+ years of hands-on experience in public cloud AWS, Google or Azure (AWS Preferred) of which at the minimum 4 years of experience in the software industry.
• Experience in overall areas in DevOps including CI/CD with build & release, Cloud, Internal tooling and production operation.
• Experience in the cloud including AWS and optionally other types of cloud such as VMWare, Openstack or colocation vendors.
• Build and operation tools that monitor backend production, Make sure backend services scale economically, Develop tooling framework, Help the dev team resolve production issues
• Experience in typical Linux based data center related tasks including bare-metal server configuration, DNS and DHCP.
• Experience deploying or managing large scale distributed Linux environments Partake in an on-call rotation alongside the engineers who build our production backends, Comfortable with large scale production systems and technologies, including load balancing, monitoring, distributed systems, and/or configuration management.
• Experience in contemporary platforms extended from cloud such as docker container, Mesos and/or Kubernetes.
• Experience in a production operation mode that includes logging and monitoring.
• Experience in NOC (Network operation center) and previous SRE experience is a big plus.

What do we offer?

We offer competitive compensation and excellent social benefits like flexible work schedule and home office policies, medical insurance, pension plan, allowances for marriage and birth, training related to your career development, gym, meal allowance, flexible remuneration scheme with its fiscal advantages and other benefits

Location:

Sant Cugat Del Valles (Barcelona, Spain) Hybrid working model (from 1 day/week office to…)

#RisEMEA#

#DigitechSpain#

#RISjobs#

As this position is a global role, international business travel will be required depending upon the business location of the successful candidate and ongoing business project activities.

Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Role: DevOps Engineer
Location: Valencia, Spain
Salary: up to €60,000
Working model: Mostly remote, 80% home office

Join a dynamic team as a skilled Site Reliability/DevOps Engineer! We're on the lookout for a seasoned professional with interest in creating innovative solutions. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of managing and advancing intricate cloud solutions for a global clientele. Collaborating closely with development teams, you'll ensure a robust working environment while actively contributing to the enhancement of the Internal Developer Platform.

Key Qualifications:
• Minimum 2 years of experience in overseeing Cloud-based infrastructures
• Proficient in IaC, DevOps, and GitOps concepts
• Expertise in CI/CD, Docker Containers, and Kubernetes
• Hands-on experience with cloud providers such as GCP, AWS, or Azure
• Openness to learning programming languages, especially Elixir
• Familiarity with pipeline management (Gitlab CI/CD) and Kubernetes administration
• Strong... problem-solving intuition

And, most importantly:
• Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with colleagues
• EU citizenship or valid work permit
• Willingness to work at the office at least twice a week

Benefits:
• Flexible hybrid work model
• 5 weeks of vacation
• Attractive office in Valencia city center with free coffee and snacks
• Flat hierarchy, state-of-the-art infrastructure
• Supportive company culture valuing every opinion
• Semi-annual dialogue talks for professional and personal growth
• International networking through events and conferences
• Generous annual well-being allowance
• Dedicated learning time and budget
• Generous 5-year anniversary present
• Private accident insurance coverage in Switzerland

If you're ready to bring your expertise to a dynamic environment and contribute to cutting-edge solutions, we invite you to apply. Join us and be a vital part of our innovative journey!

Evelyn Hay - Recruitment partner
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Autonomous Database Engineer (Cloud DBA & DevOps)
jobs_results.description:
The Autonomous Database Team is responsible for building the Cloud service framework powering various Oracle Autonomous Database cloud services, including Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP).

The framework automates deployment, scaling and management of databases in the cloud. It is built on top of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Layer.

The Autonomous Database cloud service framework features APIs to handle all lifecycle management operations of databases.

It also performs operations autonomously based on internal and external events. The team has the unique opportunity to make significant contributions to the full stack of Oracle technology, from database kernel to cloud service platform and to customer-facing portals.

You will be responsible for deploying fixes for the Autonomous Database service with a deep focus on architecture, production operations, performance management, deployment and release engineering.

You will work with... multiple cross-functional teams helping deliver new and outstanding experiences to our stakeholders while ensuring reliability and performance.

The successful candidate will be expected to interface with both senior management and the various delivery teams across OCI and database security and compliance architecture team to define and maintain our compliance posture in an environment of increasing regulatory expectations and growth.

We are a dynamic and enthusiastic team with great emphasis on go-getters and proactive individuals.

Overview from with links to other collateral :

In this role you will need to :
• Operate and performs maintenance to cloud database services running within the region.
• Assess, prioritize, and communicate risks and urgency to leadership and engineering teams
• Take ownership of the implementation and production operations of a wide array of core system platform solutions
• React to production deficiencies by continuously implementing automation, self-healing, and real-time monitoring to production systems
• Ensure thorough documentation of incidents through company-standard reporting methods.
• Stay informed of cloud infrastructure stacks

Preferred Qualifications :
• At least a Bachelor’s degree, in Computer Science, MIS or another technical field, or equivalent work experience.
• Solid experience with Linux.
• Experience troubleshooting complex software and / or networking issues.
• Knowledge on Cloud computing architecture, primarily Identity, Compute and Networking
• Expert level experience, understanding, implementation and troubleshooting of Oracle Database technology including RAC, Dataguard, ASM, RMAN preferred.
• Development skills utilizing Python, shell, SQL, Terraform
• Prior DevOps or continuous delivery and deployment experience preferred
• Strong communication and analytical skills
• Proven ability to quickly learn new technical domains and then train others.

Career Level - IC3

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer Internship
jobs_results.description:
If you are ready to start your professional career in the Tech world, this is your opportunity!

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

A Devops Engineer Intern willing to learn and gain experience working hand to hand with our top-notch DevOps team.
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
• Strong interest in DevOps or related field
• Familiarity with deployment automation tools such as Jenkins, Ansible, or Chef
• Familiarity with cloud-based environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
• Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes
• Basic understanding of networking, security, and infrastructure architecture
• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

Bonus points:
• Basic Linux skills. Be comfortable working with a terminal. You will learn everything else!

Smadex is a cutting-edge ad-tech company: we process more than 2,5 million ad requests per second, replying under 100ms. Every day we generate... several TBs of data that need to be processed, analyzed and aggregated, so our real-time components get smarter every day. We need you to help us keep our platform in motion!
• What will you do at Smadex?
• Gain hands-on experience with various tools and programming languages in the field of software development
• Help building a cloud-based platform using modern technologies, collaborating and learning from other highly-skilled peers
• Participate in code reviews, contribute to technical and architectural decisions, collaborate in a fast-paced environment where every opinion counts!

Our tech stack is 100% based on AWS, running thousands of instances and containers in 7 different regions.

Technologies: Java, NodeJS, Python, Redis, AWS, Nginx, HAProxy, Apache Druid, MySQL, Memcache, Netflix Hollow, and much more :)

If you become a member of our team, you will get the chance to:
• Have a real impact on one of the hottest ad-tech in Barcelona and Europe
• Work with a team of kick-ass developers and company support in your professional development
• Achieve experience in a multicultural, young & talented environment with friendly peeps from more than 22 different nationalities!
• Flexible working hours
• Daily fresh fruits & snacks
• DIR gym membership.
• TGIF’s monthly activities, team-building events, and work anniversary celebrations!

If you want to know more about us visit our website , and for a sneak peek of the cool stuff we build check this out!

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you a dedicated and skilled DevOps Engineer with a passion for optimizing streaming services in the OTT industry? Are you ready to take charge and lead initiatives that drive operational excellence in a fast-paced OTT technology landscape? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

At 2Coders, our mission is to revolutionize the OTT experience through cutting-edge infrastructure and DevOps practices. We are actively seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team in Skopje.
Responsibilities

● Implement and manage robust security measures to safeguard company and client applications.

● Utilize your strong DevOps expertise to streamline and enhance our security protocols.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance system reliability.

● Proactively identify and address security vulnerabilities, staying ahead of evolving threats.
Requirements

● Minimum of 5 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer.

● Proficiency in Python for... scripting and automation.

● Strong background in Azure, with preferable experience in AWS.

● Maintaining security measures in a DevOps environment.

● Proficient in CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure as code.

● Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
What we offer

● Full-time, permanent position (40h/ work week).

● Flexible hours/ work from home when needed.

● Personal development & career growth plan.

● Whole new set of gadgets such as Brand new MacBook Pro.

● Modern office located in Synergy Business center, equipped with the latest technology.

● Snack bar with chips & refreshments.

● An opportunity to learn and develop – we give every employee a budget per year to grow their skills outside the company.

● Gaining experience in a highly specialized, exciting and growing sector.

● Company parties and team-building adventures.
Become a part of our team

We specialize in OTT and video experience platforms, one of the fastest-growing markets globally. We believe in fostering a dynamic and supportive working environment, with ample opportunities for training, development, work-life balance, and location-related benefits. If you are passionate about coding and meet our qualifications, we look forward to receiving your application!
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: DevOps and Platform Engineer, Terraform and Kubernetes (AWS)
jobs_results.description:
DevOps and Platform Engineer, Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS

At DataBeacon our mission is to revolutionize the aviation industry using a modern technology stack, open source technologies and lean architectures.

Our first product is SimpliFID, an Aerodrome Flight Information Service (AFIS) that covers most functionalities of a radar system at a fraction of the costs. Built in Rust, Python and TypeScript, it sources data from ADB-S and Mode-S Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) systems over Asterix CAT021 Surveillance Data Exchange protocol.

Currently, SimpliFID is being certified and deployed in 6 small to mid-sized airports, with another 15+ planned for 2025+. Our main focus is on scalability, security and additional internal projects around real-time data services.

In anticipation to the exciting challenges ahead, we look forward to extend our engineering team with an exceptional DevOps and Platform Engineer focused on Kubernetes (EKS) and Terraform on AWS.

What would you do:
•... manage DataBeacon platform using K8s manifests and kustomize + Helm,
• provision of infrastructure using Terraform,
• work with a small and highly motivated, skilled team of engineers,
• participate in the company technical decisions and roadmap,
• space to experiment and try-out new exciting technologies,
• have minimal administrative overhead and the possibility to create a real impact,

You must have:
• at least 2+ of professional experience in DevOps, automation, CD/CI, observability and reliability,
• at least 1+ years of experience with AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
• experience with IaC using Terraform and terragrunt,
• have a good command of English and good communication skills,
• be located in Madrid or surroundings.

Nice to have:
• fundamentals of operating systems, databases and networking,
• experience as database administrator or linux OS in general,
• proficiency in Python and/or Rust programing languages,
• professional experience in highly regulated sectors,
• affinity for aviation in general.

What we offer:
• a total of 25 vacation days, including Christmas' and New Year’s eves,
• hybrid and work-from-home policies tailored to your needs,
• a beautiful office in the center of Madrid, near Alonso Martinez,
• yearly budget for continuous learning, conferences, books, courses,
• a fairly generous compensation, reviewed yearly, and a personal growth plan.

If this position and our mission resonates with you, we would be excited to hear from you

jobs_results.title: DevOps for Data Products & Services (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Kapsch TrafficCom develops smart solutions to make mobility safer, more sustainable and efficient for everybody. We design, build and operate traffic management systems including connected vehicles technology and mobility demand management as well as tolling services for cities, roads, tunnels and bridges around the world.

We develop data and video analytics platforms, building on state-of-the-art technologies including AI, machine learning, big data and cloud services to enable the digitalization of mobility.

Your Responsibilities
• You deploy and operate the infrastructure needed to power our data products and services
• You implement and improve continuous integration and continuous delivery
• Automating what is not, addressing security and data protection procedures
• You expand our platform’s observability through monitoring, logging and alerting
• Working hand-in-hand with the development team to contribute to our solutions
• You ensure that our environments operate at peak... efficiency

Your profile
• Proven experience as DevOps / Ops / SRE Engineer
• Degree in Information Technology or equivalent practical experience
• Great passion for DevOps and Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS)
• Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Ansible, Helm, Terraform)
• Practical knowledge of CI / CD tools preferably Gitlab
• Experience in deploying and operating container technologies on-premise and in the Cloud
• Working experience in one or more of the following : Python, Golang, Java, Scala
• Good oral and written English (Spanish or German is a plus)

Our offer to you
• Challenging limits of mobility for a healthy world without congestion
• An interesting full-time position with high responsibility within one of our growing markets
• Work in a friendly environment within a dynamic international team
• Onboarding with experienced colleagues to get familiar with the business and the domain
• Social benefits of a modern company, e.g. Homeoffice, mobile devices, flexible working hours, bridge day regulation etc.
• Start date : as soon as possible
• Market-compatible gross salary starting at € 50.000 p.a., however it can be adapted according to your qualifications and relevant experience
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
**Who are you?**
- Capable of automating the entire CI/CD pipelines and cycles.
- Can automate configuration management repetitive tasks.
- Think about security first and make sure that the best safe practices are applied.
- Knowledge of how highly available systems work.
- Know Agile concepts and principles.
• *What makes you successful?**
- Experience working on Linux based infrastructure.
- Familiarity with networking concepts and security practices behind it like ufw and firewalld.
- Working experience with Git.
- Two years working with cloud workloads (Azure/AWS).
- Working knowledge with IaC like Ansible.
- Scripting skills in Bash or Python.
- Working experience with CI tools like Jenkins, Github/Gitlab pipelines and Tekton.
- Working experience with Helm and GitOps tools like ArgoCD and Kustomize.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
- Working knowledge with monitoring systems ( Grafana, Prometheus).
• *What is considered as a plus?**
- CKAD certification.
- Have worked with... messaging systems like (RabbitMQ, NATS) and SQL/NoSQL databases like Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL.
- Good knowledge of HA proxy and Nginx web servers.
- Have been part of the on-call rotation schedule
